about: Questions for the model test bench (Settings > AI model > Compare models, or compare-models.bat). expect: words one of which the answer must contain; lang: the language the answer must be in; action: the action a PC request must produce; code: the language of the fenced code block; max_words: the longest answer that still counts as brief (default 120).
